set_text.text: 01 / GARMENT FRAMEWORKS
Heavyweight Apparel & Curated Blanks
High-Standard Fleet Gear · Premium Tailored Cuts

We prioritize heavyweight tees so your crew can work hard and the gear stands up to real-world abuse. Our styles hit the exact balance between heavy-duty durability and clean visual cuts your team will actually want to wear off the clock. We know the top garment profiles inside and out — let us suggest the right base for your job, or we will source your specific brand request to spec.
Heavy-Duty Fleet Tees
Gildan Hammer Tee (H000): 6.0 oz · High-Standard Heavyweight. Solid industrial baseline built for high-volume durability and daily workwear.
Gildan Hammer Maxweight (75000): 7.0 oz · High-Standard Maxweight. Ultra-dense cotton structure providing maximum fabric weight and structural shape retention.
Hanes Beefy-T: 6.1 oz · High-Standard Classic. Time-tested ring-spun heavy cotton with a roomier classic fit.
Premium & Styled Tees
AS Color 5001: 5.3 oz · Premium-Standard. Ultra-soft, combed cotton with a refined modern drape for elevated lifestyle lines and retail products.
Heavy Fleece & Hoodies
Gildan Heavy Blend (18500): 8.0 oz · Mid-Weight Standard. Reliable everyday fleece layer for versatile company deployments.
Independent Trading Co. (IND5000P): 13.5 oz · Heavy Premium. Overbuilt, ultra-heavyweight fleece with dense loopback structure, metal eyelets, and premium hand-feel.
Structured Headwear
Custom Embroidered Hats: Custom 5-panel, 6-panel, and dad hat silhouettes featuring high-density 3D puff or flat embroidery.

set_text.text: 02 / PRINT PLACEMENTS & CANVAS MAPPING
Print Locations & Layout Options
Standard Placements · Custom Sleeve & Chest Hits
Every garment has optimal print zones. We map artwork to match the physical drape of the fabric so your graphics stay crisp and visible under motion.
Standard Large Back Print: The primary visual anchor. Ideal for bold company branding, full-scale artwork, or fleet identification.
Left / Right Pocket & Chest Hit: Subtle, clean branding placed over the left chest or directly on pocket seams.
Full Chest Coverage: Wide-format front placement for high-impact visual statements.
Sleeve Prints (Left / Right): Additional brand hits running down the forearm or capped on the shoulder seam.

set_text.text: 03 / COLOR SCIENCE & INK MECHANICS
Color Matching & Fabric Contrast
PMS Pantone System · Expert Layout Guidance

Great printing requires strict control over ink-to-fabric contrast. We evaluate your logo, brand guidelines, and visual vision to recommend the exact ink formulations and base layers needed for maximum pop.
Pantone Matching System (PMS): We utilize solid Pantone Solid Coated numbers to guarantee exact color recreation for established brand guidelines.
In-House Color Selection: If you do not have exact PMS codes, our team uses a trained eye to select complementary ink shades that pop cleanly off dark or heathered fabrics.
Underbase Chemistry: High-opacity white underbases are applied beneath colored inks on dark garments to prevent fabric bleed and keep colors bright after repeated washes.
